messages:
Anya: Hey folks — anyone up for a casual Smash Ultimate / Switch get-together at the office this Friday evening? Thinking 7pm, bring controllers if you have them. :smile:
Matt: Ooh count me in. I can bring my Switch + dock. I have one pro controller and one joy-con pair.
Kai: I can bring a TV (55") and HDMI. Do we need ethernet for local play or is Wi‑Fi fine?
Lisa: Wi‑Fi is fine for Smash. If we do any Mario Kart or Smash teams with 4 players, I vote for wired for fewer hiccups. I can bring an extra ethernet cable.
Sudhir: I have two wired USB-C adapters for Switch docks in case anyone forgets. Also I'm happy to host a mini bracket if people want prizes. :trophy: 
Anya: Nice — thanks Kai, Lisa, Sudhir. Matt do you want to grab snacks / chips? I'll handle pizza ordering.
Matt: Yep I can grab snacks. Any dietary restrictions?
Lisa: Gluten-free pizza would be great, thanks.
Kai: Vegan option appreciated too.
Anya: noted. I'll do two regular, one GF, one vegan.
Matt: Quick logistics Q: Do we have enough controllers for a 4-player free-for-all rotation? I can bring a wired fight stick if anyone wants to try that lol.
Sudhir: We should have ~6 controllers total between people. If we run doubles bracket we can cycle. Fight stick welcome but maybe save it for exhibition matches. :grin:
Anya: ok plan: start 7pm, casual sets, then 8:30 bracket for whoever wants in. Bring controllers, chargers, and your A-game.
Kai: RSVP: in. Can someone create a calendar invite?
calendar-bot: Event created: "Fri Game Night — Smash + Switch" on Friday 19:00 in Office — Attendees: Anya, Matt, Kai, Lisa, Sudhir.
Lisa: lovely. Also @Matt can you price check drinks when you shop? no crazy craft IPA unless it's cheap. :sweat_smile:
Matt: lol noted. I’ll keep it reasonable.
Anya: Any objections to keeping this PG-13? We had that weird 4am Smash rage in the past. :eyes:
Sudhir: Agreed. Early curfew this time. :laughing:
Kai: I'll bring spare controllers and a power strip. See you all Friday!
Matt: See ya — hype :rocket:
Anya: Thanks team — ping me if you want to add someone to the invite.
